name: agentwares
description: agentguard, an MCP policy proxy, set up from inside Claude Code: dry-run first, then spend caps, approvals for destructive tools, a kill switch and a hash-chained audit log. Open source, no account.

plugins.name: agentguard
plugins.description: Put agentguard in front of this project's MCP servers and read what an agent run did or would have done. /agentguard:init runs `npx @agentwares/agentguard init`; /agentguard:report explains the dry-run report.
